paragraphs: A Mercedes-Benz M270 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to - the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required - submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Mercedes already has instead - strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most M270 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting - sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call - particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild - a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle - restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six M270-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Mercedes-Benz M270 engine?
faqLeft.a: The M270 is Mercedes-Benz's turbocharged inline-four petrol engine, produced from 2011 to 2019. It was offered in 1.6L and 2.0L capacities and fitted across six model lines.

faqLeft.q: Which Mercedes models use the M270?
faqLeft.a: A-Class (W176), B-Class (W246), CLA (C117), GLA (X156), SLC (R172) and Sprinter (W906) - see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the M270 differ between Mercedes models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, mounting, and vehicle-specific components differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. This is particularly pronounced between passenger-car and Sprinter applications.

faqLeft.q: Is an M270 from one Mercedes model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. An M270 from an A-Class isn't a drop-in match for an M270 from a Sprinter - ancillaries, mounting, and vehicle-specific components all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-Benz M270 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on M270 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an M270 from an A-Class?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M270 in the A-Class (W176) is one of the most common applications we see, across the A 180, A 200, A 220 and A 250.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an M270 from a Sprinter?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M270 in the Sprinter (W906 112/113) is a commercial-vehicle application we work on, with the relevant ancillaries accounted for once your exact model is confirmed.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Mercedes-Benz M270 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Mercedes if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an M270 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most M270 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history - a particular concern given how many different M270 applications exist across the Mercedes range - and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
